example_sentences_in_bangla: তার ইমানদারি দেখে সবাই বিশ্বাস করে।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone trusts him because of his integrity.
An honest person's words carry truth.
history: Derived from the Arabic term 'iman' meaning religious faith, adapted in Bengali to signify moral honesty and trustworthiness, especially in Muslim-influenced contexts.
note: This term is more of a conceptual expression than a traditional proverb, deeply embedded in everyday moral discourse.
